narrative.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Shadow Goggles, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
narrative.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
narrative.offerRewardText: My new shadow goggles! <Without another word, the goblin tossed a handful of coins your way with one hand while the other swiped the item out of your grasp. The transaction was completed and his attention lost before you had a moment to process what happened.>
